entries.rationale: The deterministic normalization tier is useful, but the optional LLM fallback remains default-off until its incremental semantic-gap recovery and latency are measured on representative supported hardware.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A representative end-to-end evaluation shows semantic-gap recovery beyond the deterministic tier, no retrieval-quality regression, and p95 normalization latency within the search timeout on supported CPU and GPU tiers.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: The LLM fallback adds no material recovery beyond deterministic normalization, exceeds the supported-tier latency budget, or is superseded by a non-LLM normalization path.

entries.rationale: Soft-boost query understanding remains default-off until representative user-query incidence and supported-hardware preprocessing latency justify adding an automatic LLM stage to every eligible search.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: Representative local-query evaluation demonstrates positive retrieval impact and p95 preprocessing latency within the search budget on supported CPU and GPU tiers, with no unresolved scheduling contention.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: Representative evaluation shows non-positive retrieval impact, unacceptable supported-tier latency, or explicit agent and user filters make the automatic preprocessing stage redundant.

entries.rationale: VLM_PROFILE remains only as a legacy inference fallback; the supported engine-profile replacement is EnvRegistry.CHAT_PROFILE.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: Restore only if VLM extraction again needs an independently supported profile contract and end-to-end extraction tests prove CHAT_PROFILE cannot represent it.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: All inference readers and packaged configuration use CHAT_PROFILE, and a repository scan finds VLM_PROFILE only in migration or compatibility tests.

entries.rationale: Strict fail-closed capability validation is default-off until every supported encoder pack declares complete capability metadata.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: Every supported encoder install pack carries complete capability metadata and startup contract tests pass with strict mode enabled for every encoder lane.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: A replacement model-manifest validator enforces the same facts unconditionally or supported legacy packs cannot be migrated without permanent fallback behavior.

entries.rationale: The batch-slot cap is retained for experimentation after measurement showed it was not the dense-corpus chunk-tail throughput lever.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A reproducible mixed-corpus benchmark shows a non-noise throughput or memory benefit on supported hardware without indexing correctness regressions.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: Representative benchmark arms remain neutral or worse, or the chunk cache no longer uses a configurable per-batch slot ceiling.

entries.rationale: Per-query adaptive fusion weighting is default-off and lacks representative cross-corpus evidence for a supported contract.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: Leak-free evaluation shows material aggregate retrieval lift across short, mixed, multilingual, and long legal corpora without a ratchet regression on any supported stratum.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: Representative evaluation is neutral or negative, or a learned fusion authority supersedes the adaptive-weight selector.

entries.rationale: The judge refinement floor is default-off because existing measurements do not establish a cross-corpus aggregate benefit.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: True post-rerank-order evaluation shows a repeatable reduction in judge-stage regressions on academic and email corpora without nDCG or latency regression.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: Corrected multi-run evaluation remains neutral or harmful, or the reranker gains an unconditional stage-non-regression mechanism.

entries.rationale: The static refinement-floor blend weight is meaningful only while the default-off judge blend experiment remains under evaluation.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A predeclared sweep selects a stable alpha across academic and email holdouts and the paired blend is promoted.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: The judge blend is removed or confidence-driven arbitration fully supersedes the static alpha.

entries.rationale: Confidence-driven judge arbitration remains default-off after a positive academic result but a small negative email result.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: Repeated true-order evaluation is net-positive on both academic and email holdouts with no supported-corpus regression.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: Wider or repeated evaluation remains net-negative on any supported corpus, or a better calibrated confidence signal replaces this gate.

entries.rationale: The divergence alpha is an experimental calibration parameter coupled to the default-off judge-arbitration gate.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A predeclared sweep identifies a stable alpha with net-positive true-order results on academic and email holdouts and arbitration is promoted.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: Judge arbitration is removed or a calibrated policy derives the weight without an operator-facing scalar.

entries.rationale: Skipping the cross-encoder can save latency but has sharper quality risk and remains independently default-off.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: Supported-hardware measurement shows material p95 latency reduction and true-order quality remains within every registered corpus ratchet.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: The skip rate or latency saving is immaterial, quality regresses, or reranker scheduling makes the skip gate redundant.

entries.rationale: Entity carriage is default-off; offline renderer evidence is positive but live-backend and agent-utility evidence remains incomplete.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A live-backend smoke and leak-free agent-utility evaluation improve two-hop completion while staying within the delivery byte budget and preserving ranking/tool schemas.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: Live evaluation shows no completion benefit, unacceptable payload growth, or evidence-span delivery fully supersedes entity carriage.

entries.rationale: The entity-carriage byte ceiling is a calibration parameter coupled to the default-off carriage experiment.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: Live and agent-utility measurements establish a ceiling that preserves the bridge entity and keeps payloads within the delivery budget, and carriage is promoted.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: Entity carriage is removed or a shared delivery-budget allocator supersedes the separate per-hit ceiling.

entries.rationale: The YAML projection controls the same default-off entity-carriage experiment as its EnvRegistry counterpart.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A live-backend smoke and leak-free agent-utility evaluation improve two-hop completion while staying within the delivery byte budget and preserving ranking/tool schemas.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: Live evaluation shows no completion benefit, unacceptable payload growth, or evidence-span delivery fully supersedes entity carriage.

entries.rationale: The YAML projection controls the same experimental entity-carriage ceiling as its EnvRegistry counterpart.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: Live and agent-utility measurements establish a ceiling that preserves the bridge entity and keeps payloads within the delivery budget, and carriage is promoted.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: Entity carriage is removed or a shared delivery-budget allocator supersedes the separate per-hit ceiling.

entries.rationale: Continuation framing is a default-off probe for whether agents stop after the first retrieval hop.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A leak-free agent-utility evaluation shows a statistically credible increase in correct follow-up searches without harmful query loops or payload-budget regression.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: The framing does not improve completion, causes harmful extra searches, or the agent protocol supplies continuation structure directly.

entries.rationale: Evidence-not-answer framing is a default-off agent-behavior probe rather than a proven supported delivery contract.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A leak-free agent-utility evaluation reduces unsupported-answer errors without reducing correct completion or exceeding the delivery budget.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: The framing is behaviorally neutral or harmful, or typed protocol metadata supersedes prose framing.

entries.rationale: Calibrated-absence framing is default-off pending evidence that its corpus-coverage warning improves agent decisions.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A leak-free agent-utility evaluation reduces false absence conclusions on zero, thin, and weak-result cases without reducing correct completion.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: The warning is behaviorally neutral or harmful, or typed coverage/confidence fields supersede prose framing.

entries.rationale: The thin-result byte floor is an experimental calibration parameter coupled to calibrated-absence framing.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A predeclared utility sweep identifies a stable byte floor across supported corpora and calibrated-absence framing is promoted.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: Calibrated-absence framing is removed or a typed evidence-coverage signal supersedes byte length.

entries.rationale: The weak-score threshold is an experimental calibration parameter whose meaning is limited to bounded fusion methods.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A predeclared utility sweep validates one threshold across supported bounded-score fusion modes and calibrated-absence framing is promoted.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: The threshold does not transfer across supported corpora or a calibrated confidence signal supersedes raw fused score.

entries.rationale: The YAML projection controls the same default-off continuation-framing experiment as its EnvRegistry counterpart.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A leak-free agent-utility evaluation shows a statistically credible increase in correct follow-up searches without harmful query loops or payload-budget regression.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: The framing does not improve completion, causes harmful extra searches, or the agent protocol supplies continuation structure directly.

entries.rationale: The YAML projection controls the same default-off evidence-not-answer experiment as its EnvRegistry counterpart.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A leak-free agent-utility evaluation reduces unsupported-answer errors without reducing correct completion or exceeding the delivery budget.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: The framing is behaviorally neutral or harmful, or typed protocol metadata supersedes prose framing.

entries.rationale: The YAML projection controls the same default-off calibrated-absence experiment as its EnvRegistry counterpart.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A leak-free agent-utility evaluation reduces false absence conclusions on zero, thin, and weak-result cases without reducing correct completion.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: The warning is behaviorally neutral or harmful, or typed coverage/confidence fields supersede prose framing.

entries.rationale: The YAML projection controls the same experimental thin-result byte floor as its EnvRegistry counterpart.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A predeclared utility sweep identifies a stable byte floor across supported corpora and calibrated-absence framing is promoted.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: Calibrated-absence framing is removed or a typed evidence-coverage signal supersedes byte length.

entries.rationale: The YAML projection controls the same experimental weak-score threshold as its EnvRegistry counterpart.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A predeclared utility sweep validates one threshold across supported bounded-score fusion modes and calibrated-absence framing is promoted.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: The threshold does not transfer across supported corpora or a calibrated confidence signal supersedes raw fused score.

entries.rationale: The on-demand NRT mode remains opt-in after its first measured arm increased reopens and reduced indexing throughput.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A clean search-load re-measure shows non-regressed query freshness and throughput, lower reopen/segment churn, and no indexing correctness failure.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: The clean re-measure does not earn its keep or an unconditional reopen strategy supersedes the mode switch.

entries.rationale: The background cadence is meaningful only for the still-unproven on-demand NRT experiment.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A predeclared search-load sweep finds a cadence meeting freshness and throughput bounds and on-demand mode is promoted.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: On-demand mode is removed or one non-configurable cadence satisfies the measured contract.

entries.rationale: The blocking-refresh staleness bound is a calibration parameter coupled to the unproven on-demand NRT mode.

exitCriteria.promoteWhen: A predeclared search-load sweep validates a bound that meets query freshness and latency SLOs and on-demand mode is promoted.
exitCriteria.removeWhen: On-demand mode is removed or the supported freshness contract supplies a fixed bound.
